throughline.zh: 台灣工業電腦與封裝設備商公布訂單、軟體整合及產品規劃，東南亞製造鏈同時揭露試產、機房工程及新增資金，數據分屬不同實現階段。
throughline.en: Taiwanese industrial-computing and packaging firms reported orders and integration plans, while Southeast Asian manufacturing releases covered trials, built data centers and fresh funding at different stages.

title.zh: 資料中心、供電與通訊韌性
title.en: Data centers, power and telecom resilience

summary.zh: Google 公布馬來西亞機房與能源投資計畫，雅加達 LG CNS 與 NTT DATA 分別公布已完工設施；台電另提出十年電力擴充構想。鴻海亞灣超算及嘉義嘉太變電所案例分別揭露液冷部署與電力、網路備援資訊，時間與容量定義各不相同。
summary.en: Google described Malaysian data-center spending while LG CNS and NTT DATA detailed separate completed Jakarta facilities; Taipower outlined planned future generation. Foxconn Visionbay and Taiwan's Jiatai substation inspection provided distinct cooling and telecom-backup examples, with different dates and capacity measures.

title.zh: 光子封裝、晶圓協作與高速材料
title.en: Photonics, wafer-fab coordination and high-speed materials

summary.zh: 毅嘉公布馬來西亞光通訊產品通過驗證，台荷發布光子封裝研發合作，志聖則決議換股增持設備控制軟體公司。聯發科宣布先進製程與封測協作人事，台郡提出 PTFE 於 2028 年放量的目標，兩者目前尚未公布新量產驗收數據。
summary.en: IChia reported qualified Malaysian optical products, Taiwan and the Netherlands detailed photonics research, and C Sun approved a proposed equipment-software share swap. MediaTek announced an advanced-process leadership appointment, while Taiflex targeted a 2028 PTFE ramp without new production-acceptance data.

title.zh: 東南亞封測、網通試產與製造擴建
title.en: Southeast Asian chip testing, networking trials and plant expansion

summary.zh: FPT 公布越南封測廠進入試運轉，合勤控亦說明越南網通生產基地試產、新代更新馬來西亞等地工廠擴建目標。南韓對東協半導體出口統計及台灣半導體設備進口數據提供貿易背景；設計產能和規劃倍率均尚待實際驗證。
summary.en: FPT described a Vietnamese chip-testing trial, Zyxel confirmed Vietnamese networking trial production, and Syntec updated Malaysia-related plant plans. South Korea's ASEAN semiconductor exports and Taiwan's equipment imports provide dated trade context; design ratings and capacity multipliers remain unverified output.

title.zh: 工業電腦接單、ODM 出貨與零組件缺料
title.en: Industrial-computing orders, ODM shipments and component shortages

summary.zh: 研華 11 月 4 日公布在手訂單及工廠擴建進度，英業達公布 10 月營收與伺服器缺料情況；群電揭露電源業務亦受記憶體及測試設備供應影響。台灣、馬來西亞與越南製造業調查分別呈現交期、新訂單與投入成本變化。
summary.en: Advantech reported backlog and factory plans, Inventec released October revenue and described supply shortages, and Chicony Power reported memory and test-equipment constraints. Manufacturing surveys in Taiwan, Malaysia and Vietnam separately traced lead times, orders and input costs.

title.zh: 台灣能源設備及東南亞材料與連接器投資
title.en: Taiwan energy equipment and Southeast Asian materials/connector investment

summary.zh: 華新麗華等企業公布能源設備合資協議，金居與湧德 11 月 4 日分別公告對馬來西亞銅箔子公司及越南連接器子公司的增資決議。台灣研發支出與日商會對半導體材料供應的觀察屬先前已發布背景，公告的股權與資金額尚不代表設備交付。
summary.en: Walsin and partners reported an energy-equipment venture, while COTECH and UDE separately disclosed Malaysian copper-foil and Vietnamese connector funding. Taiwan R&D statistics and Japan business commentary are earlier context; announced funding does not establish delivered equipment.
